column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the spring rain” is rendered “the latter rain,” and “thunderclouds” “flashing clouds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the teraphim” is rendered “the idols,” “wickedness” “delusion,” and NKJV supplies “the people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the leaders (male goats)” is rendered “the goatherds,” “I will visit [judgment]” “I will punish,” and “his majestic horse” “His royal horse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the corner” is rendered “the cornerstone.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “their enemies” as the object of “tread down.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will answer them” is rendered “I will hear them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have redeemed them” is rendered “I will redeem them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and [room] will not be found for them” is rendered “Until no more room is found for them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the sea, trouble” is rendered “through the sea with affliction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will go about in his name” is rendered “they shall walk up and down in His name.”
